_comment: Human-curated lore entries for AVOID PRIME | FT. Every citation must be a msg id that exists in data/seed/normalized-messages.jsonl (verified by 05_lore.py). Quotes are taken verbatim from the sanitized archive.

entries.title: Origin and identity
entries.summary: AVOID PRIME | FT was created on 2026-09-28 at 17:39 by ~Apip inside the WhatsApp community AVOID CITY, with the squad roster being drafted within the first ten minutes and admin-approval locking turned on the same evening.

citations.note: admin approval turned on same day
first roster list: 1. AVO|GACOR CB FORD

entries.title: GB Prime = Grup Besar Prime (colloquial)
entries.summary: "gb prime" appears as a colloquial reference to Grup Besar Prime, a related group in the same ecosystem — a tournament focus instruction, a quiet-day complaint, an offhand 'haven't opened it', plus one direct comparison ('prime is livelier than gb'). It is not this group's name and not an unrelated community.

citations.note: @all yg gb prime di turnamen itu untuk fokus di turnamen yak
tp emg dibandingin prime/gb lebih rame prime (direct comparison)

entries.title: Roster culture: AVO| prefix and signup templates
entries.summary: Squad posts follow a fixed template — 'uid posisi nickname no wa' — and members style themselves AVO|<name> with a position (ST/CB/WF/GK). The convention started in the very first roster message and recurs in every tournament signup.

citations.note: ARELYNS FLASH PEAK CHAMPIONSHIP — SEASON 3 form

entries.title: Matchmaking ritual: lawan siapa / gas lawan X
entries.summary: Spar coordination has a fixed call-and-response: someone asks 'lawan siapa' (who's the opponent), someone answers with a rival name and 'gas'. Eclipse, Impact, AGI, Centra and Fision are the recurring sparring partners; 'Avoid League' schedule posts organize the fixtures.

entries.title: eFootball meta-talk: cut turn, long ball, fake shoot
entries.summary: Tactical coaching is constant: 'cut turn' before shooting, 'long ball' as the fallback against lag, 'fake shoot' tricks, and goalkeeper blame after every conceded goal ('kiper nya...').

citations.note: Pernah pakai cut turn gk sebelum shoot?
better buang long ball aja ya
Kiper nya padahal udah berapa Kali penyelamatan

entries.title: Member tags with honorifics: YONKOU強, Alfikra神, AMBAKING
entries.summary: Core members are tagged with Japanese-styled honorifics (強 = strong, 神 = god) inside mentions like @~YONKOU強 and @~Alfikra神; AMBAKING is both a member tag and a roster position filler.

citations.note: Avoid Prime VS ST Alfikra WF AMBAKING CB CB Benned GK

entries.title: mandul — the signature roast
entries.summary: 'mandul' (barren) is the standard roast for an inactive team or player, nearly always paired with jir and the 🗿/🤣 reaction. 477 hits over 51 days, aimed at teams, opponents and friends alike.

entries.title: Coordination catch-phrases
entries.summary: The group runs on short coordination formulas: 'info mabar', 'info rank', 'p info main lah', 'yg main?', 'main kah', 'ayo mabar', 'jam brp/berapa' — always lowercase, always one line.

citations.note: p info main lah abis ini
ayo mabar rank full tim klo bisa

entries.title: TikTok clip sharing as social currency
entries.summary: vt.tiktok.com links are shared across 32 different days (69 occurrences), usually game highlights — the group's way of showing off and roasting each other's gameplay.

citations.note: roster post containing vt tiktok link

entries.title: Omak joins the group (2026-11-23)
entries.summary: On the archive's final day the bot was added ('You added bot new'), greeted with 'selamat datang member baru', welcomed by Biapis FP with 'Wih ada bot disinih', and immediately tested with '!myid'.
